positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: how does remember return without blocking, and how is extraction progress observed after the receipt is handed back?
positions.why: Both statements read in the same direction: the contract is settled (ratified) and its shape is an immediate receipt plus a watched cursor rather than a blocking call. src-1 states the terms as ratified fact — receipt in seconds, cursor polling, no lost work if the client drops the receipt — while src-2 states the dispatch mechanics as a key decision, with the agent either polling the run or getting the reaction piggybacked on a later call. The temporal reads differ (src-1 past/realis, src-2 future/irrealis) but that is the same frame seen from the settled decision and from the flow it licenses; the set holds both without resolving them.
